image_description: A Gothic-style stone altar situated within a vaulted sanctuary. The altar features a raised rectangular table structure with an ornate, carved stone superstructure (reredos) containing a central arched niche and decorative molding. It is flanked by tall stained-glass windows and sits beneath a ribbed stone ceiling. The lighting is dim, creating high contrast between the illuminated windows and the shadowed stone architecture.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The lead cames (lines) in the stained glass appear slightly wavy and inconsistent in thickness, lacking the rigid straightness typical of real glasswork. Some panes show slight 'melting' or blending of colors.
The interior of the central arch is an indistinct black void with no discernible depth or object definition, suggesting a failure to render the recessed space accurately.
The ribs of the ceiling vault converge slightly irregularly, and the geometry of the boss (center point) is somewhat soft and ill-defined.
